calculator_engine: function vip(initial,target,ret,years){const n=years*12;const r=ret/100/12;let portfolio=initial;let invested=initial;for(let t=1;t<=n;t++){const targetVal=initial+target*t;const needed=targetVal-portfolio*(1+r);invested+=Math.max(0,needed);portfolio=targetVal;}return{finalValue:portfolio,invested};}
